$comment: Amazon Polly voices and prices for calls: the one source for packages/core (voice choice, speech metering) and infra/cdk (synth-time engine check, speech cost alarms). Voices are the adult US-English voices with the engines each has in us-east-1, neural first (Polly developer guide, 'Available voices', checked 2026-10-16). Prices are on-demand USD per million characters (aws.amazon.com/polly/pricing, checked 2026-10-16). platformVoice speaks for personas without a consented voice of their own; it must exist on both engines.
